San Antonio's program has a name worth learning: **Brush & Bulky.** Furniture rides in the "bulky" half, and the city collects it **twice a year per route, on the city's schedule, not yours.** If your next collection week is four months out, that's the wait.

## The Brush & Bulky Rules, Exactly

- **Two bulky collections per year per address**, scheduled by route. Look up your week by address on the Solid Waste Management site, or watch for the door hanger about 10 days before.
- **Brush and bulky must be separate piles.** Mixed piles can be skipped entirely.
- **Pile limit: 8 cubic yards** (about 6 by 6 by 6 feet), placed within two feet of the curb, not blocking sidewalks.
- **Furniture needs no prep**, mattresses included.
- **Four Bulky Waste Collection Centers** accept furniture free, year-round, for city solid-waste customers. If you have a truck, this is the way around the schedule.
- **Out-of-cycle collection exists for a fee**, requested through 311 (210-207-6000), starting around $50 for a single item, and not available during regularly scheduled weeks.

## When the Schedule Fails You

Twice a year is the longest gap of any major Texas city. Move-outs, military PCS timelines, and new-couch deliveries don't wait for it, and a couch staged in the garage for a season rarely comes out [donatable](/blog/eco-friendly-living/can-couch-be-donated/).

When timing matters: [couch removal in San Antonio](/tx/san-antonio/couch-removal/) starts at $90 any week of the year, carry-out included, [same-day in most ZIPs when booked before 2PM local time](/book-online/). A couch in good shape should go to [donation pickup](/tx/san-antonio/donation-pickup/) instead of the pile. Pricing by item is in the [cost guide](/blog/junk-removal/how-much-does-couch-removal-cost/).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How often does San Antonio pick up bulky items?

Twice a year per route, on the city's published schedule. A door hanger arrives roughly 10 days before your week, and you can look up the approximate week by address.

### Can I put a couch out with regular trash in San Antonio?

No. Furniture is bulky waste and is collected only during your scheduled Brush & Bulky week, at a drop-off center, or through paid out-of-cycle collection.

### What does out-of-cycle bulky pickup cost in San Antonio?

Fees apply per request, starting around $50 for a single item, arranged through 311. It can't be requested during your regularly scheduled collection week.

### What's the fastest couch disposal option in San Antonio?

Booked removal runs year-round: [same-day across most of San Antonio](/tx/san-antonio/couch-removal/) when booked before 2PM local time, with the carry from inside your home included.
